name: Kaveh
title: Empyrean Reflection
description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

skills.name: Schematic Setup
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Uses Mehrak to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Artistic Ingenuity
skills.description: Uses Mehrak's mapping ability for offensive purposes, initiating a radial scan that deals AoE Dendro DMG. It will also scan all Dendro Cores in its AoE and cause them to immediately burst.
skills.info: Mehrak was created through the modification of ancient technology and may have some other functions apart from mapping work...

skills.name: Painted Dome
skills.description:
Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
· Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden.
· All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
· Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.
skills.info: "Every building style includes the architect's unique worldview, and from this angle, one can say that the buildings themselves are coalescences of human memories."

passives.name: An Architect's Undertaking
passives.description: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

passives.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
passives.description:
During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.

passives.name: The Art of Budgeting
passives.description: When Kaveh crafts Landscape, Building, and Courtyard-type Furnishings, he has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.

constellations.name: Sublime Salutations
constellations.description: Within 3s after using Artistic Ingenuity, Kaveh's Dendro RES and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

constellations.name: Grace of Royal Roads
constellations.description: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during Painted Dome.

constellations.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Painted Dome by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Feast of Apadana
constellations.description: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

constellations.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Artistic Ingenuity by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
constellations.description: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during Painted Dome, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as AoE Dendro DMG and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

outfits.name: Gold Pinions in Flames Bathed
outfits.description: Kaveh's outfit. A notable tailor from Treasures Street created these clothes in imitation of the lovely sight of birds extending their wings in flight and would only sell them to those who knew how to appreciate their beauty.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I'm glad you gave me a chance. I always think it takes people with similar tastes to sustain a pleasant conversation.\nNice to meet you — I'm Kaveh, an architect. If you have a project you'd like me to work on, then I'll need a detailed description of what you have in mind.

voices.title: Chat: Beauty
voices.text: The ability to appreciate beauty is an important virtue.

voices.title: Chat: Overcoming Boredom
voices.text: It's good to get out and stretch your legs once in a while. People aren't made to stay cooped up inside all the time.

voices.title: Chat: Final Polish
voices.text: My latest design's getting there, but there's still room for improvement. Better make my finishing touches before the deadline creeps up...

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Huh? When did it start to rain? Oh no, I forgot to bring an umbrella...

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Did you see that? That bolt of lightning was such an interesting shape!

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Brrr... Feels like the wind's creeping in from the back of my shirt... and also the front...

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: I get dizzy and sleepy when I'm under the sun for too long... It's a similar feeling to pulling an all-nighter on a work project.

voices.title: In the Desert
voices.text: This isn't my first trek into the desert, but I can never get used to the heat... *sigh* Is there no shade anywhere...?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Did you sleep well? I hope you have a great day today. And that you don't run into someone who ruins your day first thing in the morning.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: This midday sun is fierce... I should go check on the building materials I left out to dry.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: There's supposed to be a great view of the stars tonight. Don't you think that's a good omen?

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Relax your mind, and let go of all your troubles. Have a good night.

voices.title: About Kaveh: Expertise
voices.text: It's fair to say I'm a pretty proud person when it comes to my area of expertise. Most scholars are when talking about their chosen fields. After all, we build our whole lives around it. I mean, if I ever stopped taking pride in my own work, then I would also forfeit the right to have any expectations of myself or anyone else.

voices.title: About Kaveh: Artistry
voices.text: Aesthetic isn't the number one priority in my work, and nor should it be: Quality and safety are paramount. But I never neglect the artistic side either. That's what sets my work apart from others'.

voices.title: About Us: Appreciation
voices.text: You must've seen the Palace of Alcazarzaray before? That's my magnum opus. I sacrificed so much for that... Everyone else thought I'd lost my mind. Haha, well, if you're not me, and you don't share my trade, I wouldn't expect you to understand. Mmm... It'd be nice to meet someone who did understand, though.

voices.title: About Us: Ideals
voices.text: I've always thought that you can never truly know a person until you understand their deepest wishes. But once you start exploring hopes and dreams, whether they're your own or someone else's... it can be a dangerous journey. You might unlock something that can't be put away again. Not everyone can face the potential consequences of that.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: I almost don't want to say this out loud, but... Sometimes, hopes and dreams bring suffering instead of happiness. Luckily, I don't mind my Vision.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: People who know what drives them to create deserve our respect. Wouldn't you agree?

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: The uninitiated often assume that the expertise of Kshahrewar architects starts with clay and ends with lumber. It's such an ignorant perspective that it's not even worth arguing against... If all it took to build a house was to smush a few random materials together, there'd be no need for this discipline in the first place... As well as being one of the building blocks of human culture and civilization, architecture is also an art form. Art does not exist in a vacuum, so I've always been mindful of the experiential factor for the occupants, and the emotional character conveyed to those looking on from the outside... Oh, and I'm always looking for better ways to integrate artistic expression and practical functionality.

voices.title: About Lesser Lord Kusanali
voices.text: Lesser Lord Kusanali is a wise and capable god. Not only is she extremely knowledgeable, she also possesses virtue far beyond mortal comprehension. I have only the utmost respect for her tolerance of others — especially in a nation of learning like Sumeru, that takes great equanimity.\nSometimes, though, I do stop to wonder... Surely even the gods must have their struggles, too? Oftentimes, confusion is the beginning of wisdom... In which case, how can we ever achieve true happiness?

voices.title: About Alhaitham: Temperament
voices.text: I guarantee you'll never meet anyone else who's as infuriating as him! And for the record, yes, I would say that to his face. Sure, he's smart, and sure, geniuses often come with a bad temper, but that's only half the story with him... He knows perfectly well how to appear friendly and likable to others, he just doesn't want to.\nIf he ever gives you the impression that he doesn't really have a temper, or that he's rigidly logical like a machine, then you just don't know him well enough yet. He definitely has a personality, it's just... too big a personality. Most people wouldn't get it.

voices.title: About Alhaitham: It's Complicated
voices.text: Alhaitham helped me out a fair amount recently. If we were still as close as we were during our student days, then I'd be thanking him every chance I got. Now, though... I can't seem to get a word of appreciation out of my mouth. Even if I could, I wouldn't want to give him the satisfaction.\nI guess you could say our relationship is something of a mixed bag these days? Honestly, with everything that's happened, it almost feels like the universe has been playing pranks on us... It's hard to make sense of it all... too much to process for one lifetime. I will say that it's not every day that you get to know someone like him — I just wish he could rein in some of the worst excesses of his personality. Okay, yeah, that's never gonna happen.

voices.title: About Tighnari
voices.text: Ah, Tighnari... He's one of the nicest guys you could know. If you've met him, you'll know what I mean. He's kind, and he has enormous expertise in his field, but he never brags about it in front of other people. And he seems to genuinely care about his work.\nBack when I was building the Palace of Alcazarzaray, I asked him for some tips on how to pick out the right ornamental plants. After he wrote back to me, he also helped me out with some other issues, too. Oh, and I almost forgot — he was the one who first introduced me to Cyno.

voices.title: About Dori
voices.text: Dori is the owner of the Palace of Alcazarzaray... Excuse me? Mine? No, don't be ridiculous. I know full well that it doesn't belong to me... I know, I know, but... argh, please, let's not go there!\nDori is a shrewd one. She knows how to coerce others into doing things for her. I, uh... For, ahem, various reasons, I now owe her a large sum of money. It all got quite complicated in the end, but... A—Anyway, I wish she'd show me a little mercy, and stop making my life a misery for the sake of Mora. I swear, she doesn't seem like a bad person at heart, so... I just don't understand, how did she turn out like this?

voices.title: About Cyno
voices.text: Cyno can come across as cold and ruthless, but he's actually a very big-hearted guy. I still remember how shocked I was when Tighnari said he was gonna introduce me to his best friend, and then a couple of seconds later, an incredibly intimidating matra comes walking through the door... I honestly never expected to meet a matra who's so comfortable hanging out with scholars. Gotta say though, I can't stand his sense of humor. It really makes my skin crawl. If he ever invites you to a meal at Tighnari's place, make sure someone's bringing beer, because no one should have to endure Cyno's humor while sober.

voices.title: About Collei
voices.text: I've met Collei quite a few times now. As Tighnari's student and assistant, she follows him everywhere. With her diligence and patience, she's much more responsible than most other kids her age. But, umm... I can also tell that she's got a lot going on inside.

voices.title: About Nilou
voices.text: Nilou's talent as a dancer is indisputable. Zubayr Theater really lucked out when they recruited her. I've heard that she has a great personality too — she always smiles and says encouraging things to her audience when she's performing. Once I can find some time, I'll have to catch one of her shows.

voices.title: About Faruzan
voices.text: Madam Faruzan doesn't mince her words, so I can understand why some students at the Akademiya are afraid of her. She doesn't have any bad intentions, though — all she wants is to devote herself completely to the research that interests her. Some people say that all Haravatat scholars are hard to get along with, and uh... heh, I'll let you be the judge of that.\nI assume she's already asked you to be her student? She sure is a little intense when she's doing the hard sell, huh... But she can walk the walk too. She really does know her stuff.

voices.title: More About Kaveh: I
voices.text: You heard that I've earned myself a little fame in Sumeru? Hahaha, don't believe everything you hear. They're exaggerating, trust me. It's easy enough to make a name for yourself in Sumeru if you stick around here long enough — honestly, I think managing to keep a low profile would be more of an achievement.\nI hope you didn't first hear about me because of my bankruptcy scandal, though. Hmph... If you're actually willing to hear me out, I could tell you about some of my more redeeming qualities, heh...

voices.title: More About Kaveh: II
voices.text: You're not thinking about enrolling in the Akademiya, are you? ...Well, if you do sign up, from a pragmatic standpoint, I'd have to advise you to steer well clear of design. Don't get me wrong — it's a fascinating subject to study, but the work is... brutal. I spent some time working under one of my seniors after I first graduated, and they worked me to the bone every day... I was constantly being ordered around like a pack animal. I really don't know how I survived for as long as I did...

voices.title: More About Kaveh: III
voices.text: While everyone's aesthetic preferences differ to a point, beauty is, on the whole, a pretty concrete concept. I do think it's possible to establish some basic objective aesthetic standards. It's possible to improve your aesthetic appreciation, too, although it takes a lot of time to get the experience. If you ever need any advice on that front, by the way, you're always welcome to come to me.

voices.title: More About Kaveh: IV
voices.text: Some people think I like to stir up trouble, but they don't know what they're talking about. Anyone trying to make any sort of progress in life is inevitably gonna come into conflict with other people from time to time. You can't just ignore the situation because you don't wanna deal with it.

voices.title: More About Kaveh: V
voices.text: I like to have a drink or two when I've got the time — it's a good way to de-stress. Hm? Oh, yeah, I mean, mostly just to pass the time, heh.\nUh... Ahem, what's that look for...? Alright, alright! I admit it! Maybe I do drown my sorrows a little more often than I was letting on. It all gets a bit too much sometimes, what with the unfinished projects, obstacles that I can't overcome, misunderstandings with other people... Don't you struggle with those kinds of things as well?

voices.title: Kaveh's Hobbies
voices.text: Music, architecture, sculpting, painting... All are worth taking the time to appreciate properly.\nI wouldn't say I'm an expert in all of them, but as long as I stay interested, maybe I can master them all one day. I mean, look — I already know how to play an instrument.

voices.title: Kaveh's Troubles
voices.text: My troubles? ...Hmm, the most obvious one would be my financial situation.\nIt's not that I can't make Mora, it's just that I can't seem to hold on to it. So many things in life require money, and if you're not careful, it just disappears... Don't worry about me, though — I'm a lot better than I used to be. I'll be more careful to live within my means in the future.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: My favorites are alcohol, warm soup, and anything with cream or cheese in it. Oh, and I'll never say no to fresh fruit.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I can't deal with anything that's too hot or spicy. If I have to eat them, I leave them to cool first so I at least don't burn my tongue.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: This is marvelous! Can you teach me how to make it?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: I bet this'd go great with a glass of wine!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: ...Huh? Uh... It's hmm... Umm...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Is it your birthday today? Well, congratulations! Birthdays are important days, and it's also one of those days in the year that gets you thinking about your family. However you spend today, I hope it makes you happy.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: This'll do nicely... Thank you.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Hmm? Got any more where that came from?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: My horizons have been broadened... I hope I can hold on to this feeling.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: The more power I wield, the more things I can accomplish. Even if achieving my goals comes at a cost, and even if all my hopes and dreams are built on pain and suffering... I don't want to turn back now.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Scanning!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Come at me!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Site clear!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Watch and learn!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Breaking new ground.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Feast your eyes!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: A new discovery!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: What a lucky find! Bet that's made your day?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: This is incredible! No, extraordinary!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: How annoying!

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: That was your last chance.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Ugh... Shoo!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Leave this to me!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Get behind me.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: So many things... I never accomplished...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Why...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Don't... crush my dreams...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ugh, hey! Cut it out...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Huh! I've been through worse.

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Need a hand?

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: I'll take care of this.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Is that the client...? Wait... Oh! It's you.
